original_query: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.211'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(tgt:Section {sectionNumber:'5.2.1'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH tgt, rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (tgt)<-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]-(src:Section) RETURN src.sectionNumber, src.sectionTitle ORDER BY src.sectionNumber LIMIT 30
question_en: Which sections reference TS 38.211 Section 5.2.1 (Pseudo-random sequence)? (finding users of this base algorithm)
reference_query:
MATCH (hub:Spec {specNumber:'38.211'})
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL
MATCH (sp:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub)
MATCH (tgt:Section {sectionNumber:'5.2.1'})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp)
MATCH (src:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(tgt)
RETURN DISTINCT src.sectionId AS sectionId
